title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 13, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked November 13, 2026 at 14:21 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C1.7 (Peaked November 12, 2026 at 20:12 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 368 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)

Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
